name: sparx — Catalog Dense
tagline: A dense, energetic template for high-volume apparel and fast-fashion catalogs.
description: A high-volume, discount-forward storefront for a fast-fashion apparel shop — a full-bleed offer hero over relentless dense product grids, per-category rails and candy-loud promo bands, in a bright near-black-chrome theme with one sale-red accent. Modelled on the dense fast-fashion catalog archetype; shipped as Voltage.
